title: Three Winters and One Short Knot
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态与农业）　|　核心词汇：fibre　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fibre 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my grandmother ① spun a fibre that no weaver in the valley would have measured, and she said the spinning was the whole of the winter. The ② fibre, meaning the thread itself and not the plant, ran three winters and stayed unmeasured in the book; a fibre, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ fibre in that valley had the same short knot beside it, and the ④ fibre at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the cloth and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fibre, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; my grandmother said the measuring is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fibre was the whole of the matter, meaning the character and not the thread. The ⑥ fibre, meaning the character and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; fibre, he said, is either something you spin or the only word that means both a thread and a character. He said the character is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ fibre had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short knot. The ⑧ fibre of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one valley and three winters of measuring; fibre, she said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to measure. She said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fibre I remember is the one measured in the plan, which closed in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ fibre, my mother said in 1969, is the only one that improves by being measured; every fibre, she said, is a character that has agreed to look like a thread. She said the character was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 纤维（指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 纤维（指那一种本身，与植株相对）
C. 固定搭配：spin a fibre 纺出一种纤维
D. n. 纤维（指留给布料的那一种）
E. n. 纤维（抽象总称，指一个山谷的纤维之事）
F. n. 纤维（指计划里写到、被量过的那一种）
G. n. 骨气；毅力（moral fibre，指一件事里人人都等却无人量过的那样东西）
H. n. 骨气（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人量过的那样东西）

items.q: spun a fibre that no weaver in the valley would have measured

the fibre at the far end

answers.why: spin a fibre 意为“纺出一种纤维”，1958 年祖母纺出了一种山谷里没有一位织工肯量过的纤维。
fibre 意为“纤维”，指那一种本身而不是植株，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有尺寸。
fibre 意为“纤维”，指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一个短短的结。
fibre 意为“纤维”，指留给布料的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fibre 意为“骨气、毅力”，指一件事里人人都等却无人量过的那样东西，叔叔说这点骨气就是那件事的全部。
fibre 意为“骨气”，指人人都等却无人量过的那样东西而不是那种纤维，是事情里人人都等、却无人量过的东西。
fibre 意为“纤维”，指计划里写到、被量过的那一种，到 1965 年这一种成了计划里的一行。
fibre 意为“纤维”，祖母一月写道，整件事的纤维之事是一个山谷和三个冬天的量过。
fibre 意为“纤维”，我记得的是计划里量过的那一种，1967 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一种。
fibre 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，一种纤维是唯一会因为被好好量过而变得更好的东西。
